# customnpcs API

Use the Markdown packages first. Don't open ../api.json directly, but use `node bin/get-class-info.js <name|fqn|package|source> [...]` to lookup types.

- api.md: noppes.npcs.api
- api/block.md: noppes.npcs.api.block
- api/constants.md: noppes.npcs.api.constants
- api/entity.md: noppes.npcs.api.entity
- api/entity/data.md: noppes.npcs.api.entity.data
- api/entity/data/role.md: noppes.npcs.api.entity.data.role
- api/event.md: noppes.npcs.api.event
- api/gui.md: noppes.npcs.api.gui
- api/handler.md: noppes.npcs.api.handler
- api/handler/data.md: noppes.npcs.api.handler.data
- api/item.md: noppes.npcs.api.item
